answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the pulse is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
